name: Amelia
source:
Originally meant to be the heir of the Edwards family of magicians, she was stripped of her status due to her abysmal magical aptitude. Consequently, she was forced to move into a haunted house.

Since she was a little child, she has used 咱 (zan) as her first-person pronoun instead of the usual 我 (wo). This may be related to her deep identification with her family, which she has retained even after being exiled.
